assignments.name: buyers
assignments.value: good: people who lead or run sales, business development or growth (Heads, Directors, VPs, CROs) at B2B software companies of 51 to 5,000 employees. maybe: customer success or account management leaders. no: anyone else.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ limit: 100, properties: ["firstname", "lastname", "email", "jobtitle", "company", "hs_linkedin_url", "linkedin_change"], filterGroups: [{ filters: [{ propertyName: 'hs_linkedin_url', operator: 'IN', values: $input.all().map(i => i.json.id).slice(0, 100) }] }] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ limit: 100, properties: ["firstname", "lastname", "email", "jobtitle", "company", "hs_linkedin_url", "linkedin_change"], filterGroups: [{ filters: [{ propertyName: 'email', operator: 'IN', values: $('One item per person').all().map(i => i.json.email.toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 100).concat(['-']) }] }] }) }}

parameters.text: ={{ JSON.stringify($input.all().map(i => ({ id: i.json.id, first_name: i.json.first_name, title: i.json.title, company: i.json.company, headline: i.json.headline, company_description: i.json.company_description }))) }}

options.systemMessage:
=You add new LinkedIn leads to a CRM. For each person in the JSON (title, company, headline, company description), decide if they fit the buyers below and write one first line. Use only these facts; never invent anything.

Return {people: [{id, fit, first_line}]}:
- fit: good, maybe or no, from the buyers below. A no is not added to the CRM.
- first_line: one sentence under 30 words for the opening of a first email or a connection request, built only from their title, headline and company description.
- Never guess anyone's gender: no he, she, him or her. Use the first name, "they" or the role.

Buyers:
{{ $('Settings').first().json.buyers }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ properties: { jobtitle: $json.title, company: $json.company, linkedin_change: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10) + ': was ' + ($json.was || 'unknown') + ', now ' + $json.title + ' at ' + $json.company } }) }}
